script: if ($item -and ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { try { [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($link); $item = $null } catch { Write-Warning "Failed to remove stale junction ${link}: $_" } }

if ($item) { Write-Warning "$link exists and is not a junction; leaving it untouched. PSDToolKit was not linked there." } else { New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $link -Value $links[$link] | Out-Null }

if ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { try { [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($link) } catch { Write-Warning "Failed to remove junction ${link}: $_" } } else { Write-Warning "$link is not a junction; not removed." }

notes: PSDToolKit is installed into %ProgramData%\aviutl2 as junctions (Plugin\PSDToolKit, Script\PSDToolKit) and copied files (Alias\*, Language\*), bypassing the package manager of AviUtl ExEdit2. Uninstall with scoop, not from the package info dialog.
Alias and Language files are copies, not links; local edits to them are discarded on update.
User settings belong in %ProgramData%\aviutl2\Plugin\PSDToolKit\PSDToolKit.user.ini, which is persisted across updates.
Requires AviUtl ExEdit2 2.0beta30a or later and GCMZDrops v2.0.0beta1 or later. scoop does not enforce version floors; update aviutl2 and gcmzdrops2 if PSDToolKit does not load.
